proc main (): eff loaded integer :=
  let strong uc: pointer =
    create(Ivalignof('unsigned char'), 'unsigned char') in
  let strong uc2: pointer =
    create(Ivalignof('unsigned char'), 'unsigned char') in
  let strong a_508: loaded integer =
    bound(
      let weak a_509: loaded integer =
        let weak a_512: loaded integer = pure(Specified(1)) in
        pure(
          case a_512 of
            | Specified(a_511: integer) =>
                Specified(catch_exceptional_condition_sub('signed int', 0, conv_int('signed int',
                a_511)))
            | Unspecified(_: ctype) =>
                Unspecified('signed int')
          end
        ) in
      pure(conv_loaded_int('unsigned char', a_509))
    ) in
  store('unsigned char', uc, conv_loaded_int('unsigned char', a_508)) ;
  let strong a_514: loaded integer =
    bound(
      let weak a_515: loaded integer = pure(Specified(300)) in
      pure(conv_loaded_int('unsigned char', a_515))
    ) in
  store('unsigned char', uc2, conv_loaded_int('unsigned char', a_514)) ;
  let strong a_531: loaded integer =
    bound(
      let weak (a_518: loaded integer, a_519: loaded integer) =
        unseq(
          let weak a_523: loaded integer =
            let weak a_525: pointer = pure(uc) in
            load('unsigned char', a_525) in
          pure(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_523))
        ,
          let weak a_527: loaded integer =
            let weak a_529: pointer = pure(uc2) in
            load('unsigned char', a_529) in
          pure(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_527))
        ) in
      pure(
        case (a_518, a_519) of
          | (Specified(a_520: integer), Specified(a_521: integer)) =>
              Specified(catch_exceptional_condition_add('signed int', __conv_int__('signed int', a_520), __conv_int__('signed int', a_521)))
          | _: (loaded integer,loaded integer) =>
              undef(<<UB036_exceptional_condition>>)
        end
      )
    ) in
  kill('unsigned ichar', uc) ;
  kill('unsigned ichar', uc2) ;
  run ret_507(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_531)) ;
  kill('unsigned ichar', uc) ;
  kill('unsigned ichar', uc2) ;
  pure(Unit) ;
  save ret_507: loaded integer (a_532: loaded integer:= Specified(0)) in
    pure(a_532)
